title: "A (Not So Gentle) Introduction To Systems Programming In ATS" by Aditya Siram
summary: Aditya Siram introduces ATS, a statically typed ML-like language that compiles to C and offers type-safe pointer arithmetic and a full proof language. The Strange Loop talk shows off C interop, concurrency and verification features with non-trivial examples.
why: Cited in Rust and systems-language threads as the best introduction to ATS, a language claimed to go beyond Rust's safety guarantees.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I recommend watching this presentation for a good idea of what ATS programming is like
